facts.claim: mRNA疫苗的概念出现于三十多年前；过去二十年的发现和技术进步解决了早期阻碍其应用的主要问题。
facts.quote: The concept of mRNA-based vaccines emerged more than three decades ago. Groundbreaking discoveries and technological advancements over the past 20 years have resolved the major roadblocks that initially delayed application of this new vaccine modality.
facts.subject: The concept of mRNA-based vaccines

facts.claim: 核苷修饰的COVID-19 mRNA疫苗快速开发，显示该平台易于开发、安全性可接受，并可大规模生产。
facts.quote: The rapid development of nucleoside-modified COVID-19 mRNA vaccines demonstrated that this immunization platform is easy to develop, has an acceptable safety profile and can be produced at a large scale.
facts.subject: this immunization platform
facts.condition: The rapid development of nucleoside-modified COVID-19 mRNA vaccines

facts.claim: 抗原设计灵活、简便，使mRNA疫苗进入针对多种病毒、细菌和寄生虫的开发阶段。
facts.quote: The flexibility and ease of antigen design have enabled mRNA vaccines to enter development for a wide range of viruses as well as for various bacteria and parasites.
facts.subject: mRNA vaccines
facts.condition: for a wide range of viruses as well as for various bacteria and parasites

facts.claim: 对mRNA疫苗作用机制的认识仍有空缺，这限制了更高效力和安全性的下一代疫苗开发。
facts.quote: However, gaps in our knowledge limit the development of next-generation mRNA vaccines with increased potency and safety.
facts.subject: gaps in our knowledge
facts.condition: the development of next-generation mRNA vaccines

facts.claim: 作者认为，深入理解作用机制、运用新技术进行理性抗原设计，并创新递送策略和接种方案，可能推动针对多种病原体的强效新疫苗开发。
facts.quote: A deeper understanding of the mechanisms of action of mRNA vaccines, application of novel technologies enabling rational antigen design, and innovative vaccine delivery strategies and vaccination regimens will likely yield potent novel vaccines against a wide range of pathogens.
facts.subject: A deeper understanding of the mechanisms of action of mRNA vaccines, application of novel technologies enabling rational antigen design, and innovative vaccine delivery strategies and vaccination regimens
facts.condition: against a wide range of pathogens

facts.claim: 综述概述mRNA疫苗平台，评估作用机制的当前认识，并介绍新型传染病疫苗配方及研究中的挑战、局限和机会。
facts.quote: This Review provides an overview of mRNA-based vaccine platforms, including the principles of mRNA design and delivery technologies, assesses current understanding of the mechanisms of action of mRNA vaccines, and highlights novel preclinical and clinical infectious disease vaccine formulations. The most important challenges, limitations and opportunities in mRNA vaccine research as well as the potential of combining mRNA platform technology with reverse vaccinology to enable novel, safe and effective human vaccines against multiple pathogens, are discussed.
facts.subject: This Review

facts.claim: 作者指出，mRNA抗原序列可快速修改，因此该平台适合针对快速演化的病原体，如流感病毒和SARS-CoV-2。
facts.quote: First, the flexibility of antigen design (the mRNA sequence can be rapidly modified) makes mRNA vaccines ideal to target rapidly evolving pathogens such as influenza virus and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2).
facts.subject: mRNA vaccines
facts.condition: rapidly evolving pathogens such as influenza virus and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2)

facts.claim: 作者报告，Moderna和Pfizer–BioNTech快速开发了核苷修饰mRNA-LNP疫苗，并在短时间内生产了数十亿剂。
facts.quote: Indeed, nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP vaccines were quickly developed by Moderna and Pfizer–BioNTech and billions of doses were manufactured in a short time frame13.
facts.subject: nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP vaccines

facts.claim: 作者称，两种配方均被证明能有效预防COVID-19导致的死亡和重症；文中另称它们在SARS-CoV-2大流行期间挽救了全球数百万人的生命。
facts.quote: Most importantly, both formulations proved to be highly effective in preventing death and severe COVID-19 and saved millions of lives globally during the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic (Box 1).
facts.subject: both formulations

facts.claim: 自扩增mRNA（saRNA）通常保留来源于甲病毒的复制酶基因，并以目标抗原替代结构蛋白基因；复制酶可产生更多抗原编码RNA。
facts.quote: This modality typically uses sequences derived from alphaviruses in which the non-structural proteins (the replicase genes that encode the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) are intact and the structural proteins are replaced with the antigen of interest15.
facts.subject: This modality

facts.claim: 在致死性小鼠模型中，编码疟原虫巨噬细胞迁移抑制因子的saRNA疫苗改善了对肝期和血期感染的控制，并使小鼠免于再感染。
facts.quote: An saRNA vaccine encoding the Plasmodium macrophage migration inhibitory factor (PMIF), which modulates the host inflammatory response to malaria171, improved control of liver-stage and blood-stage Plasmodium infection and provided complete protection from re-infection in a lethal murine model.
facts.subject: An saRNA vaccine encoding the Plasmodium macrophage migration inhibitory factor (PMIF)
facts.metric: control of liver-stage and blood-stage Plasmodium infection

facts.claim: 综述认为，mRNA疟疾疫苗领域近期取得显著进展，并对未来用于人类表示希望。
facts.quote: Overall, there has been significant recent progress in the field of mRNA-based malaria vaccines, providing hope that such vaccines will be available for humans in the foreseeable future.
facts.subject: mRNA-based malaria vaccines
facts.condition: in the field of mRNA-based malaria vaccines

facts.claim: 综述指出，当前一代mRNA疫苗仍有需要克服的局限；其中许多挑战并非mRNA疫苗独有，也适用于其他疫苗平台。
facts.quote: Although the nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform technology proved to be highly effective during the COVID-19 pandemic and is an important part of our armamentarium for pandemic preparedness, the current generation of mRNA vaccines has limitations that need to be overcome to further increase the value of this vaccine modality.
facts.subject: the current generation of mRNA vaccines
facts.condition: to further increase the value of this vaccine modality

facts.claim: 疫苗临床免疫原性的临床前模型预测能力不足；H10流感疫苗在雪貂中诱导约1:3,000的HAI滴度，在人体中则诱导短暂、约1:100的HAI滴度，且在6个月内衰减。
facts.quote: A stark example is an H10 influenza virus vaccine candidate developed by Moderna. The haemagglutinin-based H10 vaccine induced very high HAI titres in ferrets, reaching ~1:3,000, which is typically very hard to induce with traditional vaccine platforms97,176. The same vaccine induced a transient, approximately 1:100, HAI titre in humans that waned within 6 months97,176.
facts.subject: The same vaccine

facts.claim: 在人类中，mRNA-LNP疫苗会触发小鼠及其他动物模型未能预测的全身炎症反应；这种差异至少部分与物种间IL-1受体信号差异有关。
facts.quote: In humans, mRNA-LNP vaccines trigger systemic inflammatory responses that were not predicted by studies in mice and other animal models. This finding is at least partially due to the interspecies differences in IL-1 receptor signalling62.
facts.subject: mRNA-LNP vaccines

facts.claim: 很少见的副作用如心肌炎或过敏性反应更难研究，其发生率通常很低，每10万剂疫苗中只有几例；因此，三期临床试验也不太可能提供相关信息。
facts.quote: Identifying and investigating very rare side effects like myocarditis or anaphylactic reactions is even more complicated as their prevalence is often very low (few events per 100,000 administered vaccine doses)188. Therefore, it is unlikely that even a phase III clinical trial will be sufficient to gain relevant information in this regard.
facts.subject: very rare side effects like myocarditis or anaphylactic reactions
facts.condition: their prevalence is often very low

facts.claim: 曾感染SARS-CoV-2的人接种mRNA疫苗后可产生一定程度的黏膜免疫，但与感染相比，通常不会在上呼吸道诱导强烈的抗体反应。
facts.quote: While COVID-19 mRNA vaccines can elicit some level of mucosal immunity in individuals who were previously infected with SARS-CoV-2 (ref. 87), they typically do not induce robust antibody responses in the URT compared to SARS-CoV-2 infection191.
facts.subject: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines
facts.condition: in individuals who were previously infected with SARS-CoV-2

facts.claim: 在既往接触过原始SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白的人群中，针对变异株的mRNA疫苗接种反应大多与原始株刺突蛋白交叉反应，而变异株特异性的新生免疫反应很少被诱导。
facts.quote: When the updated vaccines were used in individuals who were previously exposed to the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 spike, most of the response was cross-reactive to the spike protein of the ancestral strain of SARS-CoV-2 (refs. 202–206), and variant-specific de novo immunity was barely induced202–206.
facts.subject: most of the response
facts.metric: cross-reactive to the spike protein of the ancestral strain of SARS-CoV-2
facts.condition: in individuals who were previously exposed to the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 spike

facts.claim: 在SARS-CoV-2未感染者中，mRNA疫苗诱导的抗体滴度常在接种后6个月内下降10–20倍；综述指出，尽管初期下降明显，刺突特异性抗体滴度最终会趋于稳定。
facts.quote: Due to the high initial mRNA vaccine-induced anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody levels, this waning appears dramatic, with often 10–20-fold reductions in titres within 6 months after immunization179. A slower antibody decay was observed with adenovirus-vectored vaccine platforms211; however, those do not induce the initial high antibody peak211. In fact, while spike-specific antibody titres induced by COVID-19 mRNA vaccines start to decrease initially, they eventually become stable.
facts.subject: spike-specific antibody titres induced by COVID-19 mRNA vaccines

facts.claim: mRNA-LNP疫苗接种者淋巴结中的生发中心反应可持续数月，但这种持续反应的意义仍不清楚。
facts.quote: It has also been observed that mRNA-LNP vaccination elicits surprisingly long (several months) germinal centre reactions in the lymph nodes of vaccinated humans84,86. These could contribute to an increased frequency of long-lived plasma cells but the significance of these persistent germinal centre reactions is still unclear.
facts.subject: these persistent germinal centre reactions
facts.condition: in the lymph nodes of vaccinated humans

facts.claim: 一项研究首次报告，直接注射的非复制型mRNA疫苗可诱导针对病毒病原体的保护性免疫应答。
facts.quote: The first published paper demonstrating that a directly injected, non-replicating mRNA vaccine can induce protective immune responses against a viral pathogen.
facts.subject: a directly injected, non-replicating mRNA vaccine

facts.claim: 两项研究共同构成首次报告mRNA疫苗大型III期临床试验结果的论文。
facts.quote: Along with Polack et al. (2020), the first report about the results of a large phase III clinical trial with an mRNA vaccine.
facts.subject: a large phase III clinical trial with an mRNA vaccine

facts.claim: 一项研究首次显示，核苷修饰可降低体外转录mRNA的炎症能力。
facts.quote: The first report showing that nucleoside modification of IVT mRNA decreases its inflammatory capacity.
facts.subject: nucleoside modification of IVT mRNA

facts.claim: 一项研究首次证明，在体外转录mRNA中引入修饰核苷可提高其可翻译性。
facts.quote: The first report demonstrating that the introduction of modified nucleosides to the IVT mRNA increases its translatability.
facts.subject: the introduction of modified nucleosides to the IVT mRNA

facts.claim: 一项研究首次使用脂质纳米颗粒递送RNA疫苗。
facts.quote: This is the first study that uses LNPs for RNA vaccine delivery.
facts.subject: LNPs

facts.claim: 一项研究首次提供核苷修饰自扩增RNA疫苗的比较数据。
facts.quote: The first study providing comparative data on nucleoside-modified saRNA vaccines.
facts.subject: nucleoside-modified saRNA vaccines

facts.claim: 一项研究首次描述双组分RNA递送平台。
facts.quote: The first study that describes a bipartite RNA-based delivery platform.
facts.subject: a bipartite RNA-based delivery platform

facts.claim: 一项研究首次使用脂质纳米颗粒递送核苷修饰mRNA。
facts.quote: The first study that uses LNPs for nucleoside-modified mRNA delivery.
facts.subject: LNPs

facts.claim: 一项研究首次详细研究脂质纳米颗粒用于体内RNA递送。
facts.quote: The first detailed study that uses LNPs for in vivo RNA delivery.
facts.subject: LNPs

facts.claim: 该纵向研究追踪COVID-19 mRNA疫苗接种后SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白抗体随时间的变化，涵盖诱导、衰减和稳定阶段。
facts.quote: A longitudinal study describing the kinetics of SARS-CoV-2 spike antibody kinetics after COVID-19 mRNA vaccination through induction, waning and stabilization phases.
facts.subject: SARS-CoV-2 spike antibody

facts.claim: 综述将该研究列为首项证明核苷修饰mRNA-LNP平台可在临床前研究中用于被动免疫治疗的研究；被动免疫治疗指提供抗体等免疫成分用于治疗。
facts.quote: The first study demonstrating that the nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform can be used for passive immunotherapy in preclinical studies.
facts.subject: nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform

facts.claim: 综述将该研究列为首项证明核苷修饰mRNA-LNP平台可成功用于人体被动免疫治疗的研究。
facts.quote: The first study demonstrating that the nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform can be successfully used for passive immunotherapy in humans.
facts.subject: nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform

facts.claim: 生产编码多种不同抗原的mRNA较为容易且灵活，这使“反向疫苗学3.0”成为可能。
facts.quote: The ease and flexibility of producing mRNA vaccines coding for many different antigens enables ‘reverse vaccinology 3.0’.
facts.subject: producing mRNA vaccines coding for many different antigens

issues.article_quote: 此后，针对病毒、细菌和寄生虫的 mRNA 疫苗也进入开发阶段。
issues.evidence_quote: The flexibility and ease of antigen design have enabled mRNA vaccines to enter development for a wide range of viruses as well as for various bacteria and parasites.
issues.reason: 证据说明抗原设计的灵活性和便利性推动了这些疫苗的开发，没有给出它们在新冠疫苗开发和大规模生产之后才进入开发阶段的时间关系。“此后”增加了证据未支持的先后顺序。
issues.suggestion: 删除“此后”，改为“抗原设计的灵活性和便利性，也推动了针对多种病毒、细菌和寄生虫的 mRNA 疫苗开发”。

issues.article_quote: 综述还提出“反向疫苗学3.0”：利用 mRNA 生产灵活的特点，测试编码不同抗原的疫苗，从而筛选可能有用的抗原。确定保护性靶抗原后，最终疫苗也可能采用其他平台。
issues.evidence_quote: The ease and flexibility of producing mRNA vaccines coding for many different antigens enables ‘reverse vaccinology 3.0’.
issues.reason: 引文仅说明，生产编码多种不同抗原的 mRNA 疫苗较为容易且灵活，使“反向疫苗学3.0”成为可能；没有交代测试和筛选流程，也没有说明确定靶抗原后改用其他疫苗平台。文章把本轮证据未提供的流程细节写成了综述内容。
issues.suggestion: 保留“生产编码多种不同抗原的 mRNA 疫苗较为容易且灵活，为综述所称的‘反向疫苗学3.0’提供了条件”，删除本轮引文未支持的筛选流程及改用其他平台的表述。

issues.article_quote: saRNA 是保留复制酶相关序列、能够在细胞内产生更多抗原编码 RNA 的 mRNA 疫苗形式。
issues.evidence_quote: This modality typically uses sequences derived from alphaviruses in which the non-structural proteins (the replicase genes that encode the RNA-dependent RNA polymerase) are intact and the structural proteins are replaced with the antigen of interest15.
issues.reason: 引文描述的是这种形式“通常”采用的设计：保留复制酶基因，并以目标抗原替换结构蛋白。文章将通常采用的设计写成了无条件定义，且“在细胞内产生更多抗原编码 RNA”的过程未在本轮引文中直接交代。
issues.suggestion: 将设计描述加上“通常”这一限定，依据引文说明其保留复制酶相关基因、以目标抗原替换结构蛋白；删除本轮引文未直接支持的扩增过程说明。

issues.article_quote: 在未感染 SARS-CoV-2 的人群中，综述报告这些抗体滴度常在接种后 6 个月内下降 10–20 倍。
issues.evidence_quote: Due to the high initial mRNA vaccine-induced anti-SARS-CoV-2 antibody levels, this waning appears dramatic, with often 10–20-fold reductions in titres within 6 months after immunization179.
issues.reason: 下降幅度和时间与引文一致，但引文没有限定对象为“未感染 SARS-CoV-2 的人群”。事实记录中的中文 claim 含有这一限定，不能据此补入 quote 未提供的研究对象条件。
issues.suggestion: 删除“在未感染 SARS-CoV-2 的人群中”，保留 mRNA 疫苗诱导的抗 SARS-CoV-2 抗体滴度、接种后 6 个月内、常下降 10–20 倍这些引文支持的信息。

issues.article_quote: 接种地点也影响免疫防御的表现。
issues.evidence_quote: While COVID-19 mRNA vaccines can elicit some level of mucosal immunity in individuals who were previously infected with SARS-CoV-2 (ref. 87), they typically do not induce robust antibody responses in the URT compared to SARS-CoV-2 infection191.
issues.reason: 引文比较的是疫苗接种与感染所诱导的上呼吸道抗体反应，并未比较不同接种地点或接种部位。文章引入了接种地点影响免疫表现的因果判断，混淆了接种部位与免疫反应发生部位。
issues.suggestion: 删除该句，直接引出引文支持的发现：与 SARS-CoV-2 感染相比，COVID-19 mRNA 疫苗通常不会在上呼吸道诱导强烈的抗体反应。

issues.article_quote: 并指出这些挑战中有许多并非 mRNA 疫苗独有，也适用于其他疫苗平台。
issues.evidence_quote: Although the nucleoside-modified mRNA-LNP platform technology proved to be highly effective during the COVID-19 pandemic and is an important part of our armamentarium for pandemic preparedness, the current generation of mRNA vaccines has limitations that need to be overcome to further increase the value of this vaccine modality.
issues.reason: 引文支持当前一代 mRNA 疫苗仍有待克服的局限，但没有说明其中许多局限也适用于其他疫苗平台。该跨平台判断仅出现在中文 claim 中，不能作为已核验引文支持的结论。
issues.suggestion: 删除这段跨平台比较，保留“当前一代 mRNA 疫苗仍有需要克服的局限”。

issues.evidence_quote: When the updated vaccines were used in individuals who were previously exposed to the ancestral SARS-CoV-2 spike, most of the response was cross-reactive to the spike protein of the ancestral strain of SARS-CoV-2 (refs. 202–206), and variant-specific de novo immunity was barely induced202–206.
issues.reason: 文章强调可快速修改抗原序列、适合应对快速演化的病原体，却遗漏了本轮证据中直接限制这一优势转化为免疫效果的发现：在既往接触过原始株刺突蛋白的人群中，更新疫苗诱导的反应大多仍与原始株刺突蛋白交叉反应，针对变异株新产生的特异性免疫很少。
issues.suggestion: 在平台灵活性或免疫局限部分补充这一发现，保留“既往接触过原始株刺突蛋白的人群”和“更新疫苗”的条件，并用通俗表述解释：多数反应仍能识别原始株刺突蛋白，针对变异株新形成的特异性免疫反应很少。
